name: Roguish Heart
body:
Prerequisites: Rogue Talent class feature

Benefit: Choose one rogue talent you have that is usable a limited number of times per day. If the talent is usable once per day, you may use it an additional time per day. If the talent is usable once per day plus once per 5 rogue levels you possess, you may use it an additional 2 times per day.

You may select this feat multiple times. Each time this feat is gained, choose a different rogue talent.
